user.title: Calendar Sync
user.description: Synchronizes events between two calendars. After adding, use “Add sync pair” to choose the calendars and rules.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Calendar Sync is already set up.

user.title: New sync pair
user.description: Pick two calendars and what is synced between them. Both directions on = two-way sync; one direction = mirror.

data.closed_mode: Changes in a calendar that is not written to

data_description.closed_mode: In a one-way pair: revert manual changes made in the target calendar, or ignore them.
data_description.propagate_deletes: Delete the event in the other calendar when it is deleted in one.
data_description.days_back: How far into the past events are synced.
data_description.days_forward: How far ahead events are synced.

reconfigure.title: Edit sync pair
reconfigure.description: Pick two calendars and what is synced between them. Both directions on = two-way sync; one direction = mirror.

data.closed_mode: Changes in a calendar that is not written to

data_description.closed_mode: In a one-way pair: revert manual changes made in the target calendar, or ignore them.
data_description.propagate_deletes: Delete the event in the other calendar when it is deleted in one.
data_description.days_back: How far into the past events are synced.
data_description.days_forward: How far ahead events are synced.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Rules transform events before they are copied. Order matters: the first matching rule that skips wins, other matching rules are applied in order.

list.title: Rules: {source} → {target}
list.description: Rules in this direction: {count}. Pick a rule to edit it, or add a new one.

cond_kind.title: Condition
cond_kind.description: When should the rule apply to an event from {source}?

data_description.value: Case-insensitive. For “regular expression” use Python syntax.

cond_hour.title: Start hour condition
cond_hour.description: Applies when the event starts in the interval [from, to) in local time.

action_kind.title: Action
action_kind.description: What to do with the matching event?

error.pair_exists: This pair of calendars is already configured.
error.calendar_unavailable: This calendar is unavailable right now.
error.read_only: This calendar cannot be written to (it does not support creating events).
error.bad_shift: Enter a non-zero shift up to 1440 minutes.

data_description.interval: How often all pairs are synchronized.

conflicts.title: Calendar sync conflict
conflicts.description:
{pair}: {count} event(s) were changed in both calendars in the same field: {items}.

Change the event in one calendar to match the other, or call the `calendar_sync.resolve_conflict` action and choose which calendar wins.

deletions_blocked.title: Calendar sync: deletions need confirmation
deletions_blocked.description: {pair}: {count} deletion(s) were blocked because too many events disappeared at once. Everything else was synchronized.

confirm.title: Confirm deletions
confirm.description: Delete the {count} blocked event(s) of {pair} in the other calendar? Press Submit only if the events were really removed on purpose.

sync_now.name: Sync now
sync_now.description: Runs a sync cycle of the selected pair right away.

confirm_deletions.name: Confirm deletions
confirm_deletions.description: Also perform deletions that were blocked by the mass-deletion guard.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Shows what a sync cycle would do, without changing anything.

resolve_conflict.name: Resolve conflicts
resolve_conflict.description: Runs a cycle in which the chosen calendar wins every conflict of the pair.

winner.name: Winner
winner.description: The calendar whose version is kept.

no_target.message: Select a Calendar Sync entity as the target.

not_a_pair_entity.message: {entity_id} is not an entity of a loaded Calendar Sync pair.

bad_winner.message: Winner must be calendar1 or calendar2.
